title: Improving Implicit Hate Speech Detection via a Community-Driven Multi-Agent Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification fairness and accuracy (True Positive Rate, True Negative Rate, Balanced Accuracy, and F1 Score) of a multi-agent hate speech detection system on implicit hate speech directed at Black and Asian populations using the ToxiGen dataset.

Measuring the moderation system's performance and fairness metrics (Balanced Accuracy, TPR, TNR) when identifying implicit hate speech targeting Muslim and Jewish communities within the ToxiGen dataset.
Assessing the classification sensitivity and specificity (Balanced Accuracy, TPR, TNR) of the moderation framework on implicit hate speech directed at women using the ToxiGen dataset.
Evaluating the hate speech detection performance and classification fairness (Balanced Accuracy, TPR, TNR) for implicit harmful content targeting the LGBTQ community using the ToxiGen dataset.
